'''Kent''' (Japanese: '''ケント''' ''Kent'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG103|A Cacturne for the Worse]]''. He is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] who competed in the [[Purika City]] [[Pokémon Contest]] with his {{p|Surskit}}.

During the [[Appeal|first round]], Kent was able to impress [[Raoul Contesta|the]] [[Mr. Sukizo|Contest]] [[Nurse Joy|judges]] enough with his performance. As a result, he was one of the contestants to make it in to the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]]. There, he went up against {{an|May}} but lost, therefore being eliminated from the competition.

He reappeared (albeit in photographs only) in ''[[AG144|A Hurdle for Squirtle]]'' and ''[[AG167|What I Did for Love!]]'', competing in the [[Saffron City]] and [[Gardenia Town]] Pokémon Contests. In both Contests he made it past the Appeal round, but proceeded to lose in the quarter-finals.
